objective: genuine sequence-family-held-out single-mutant MAE below 0.30 kcal/mol, with a membrane-protein/GPCR application

current_historical_estimate.interpretation: Operational baseline only. This test was used by prior promotion gates and is no longer an untouched lockbox.

split_integrity.required_change: Use sequence-family clusters for development folds and freeze a new prospective family- and assay-held-out outer set.

measurement_and_oracle_checks.interpretation: Calibration, seed averaging, or protein offsets cannot credibly close the gap; only a label-leaking same-site oracle crosses 0.30.

gpcr_domain_shift.interpretation: Generic kcal/mol accuracy does not establish GPCR accuracy; receptor-held-out quantitative measurements are required.

remediation.core_training_code: Future single, state-potential, and multi-mutant production eligibility now uses validation metrics plus exact algebra only; historical test metrics are reporting-only.
remediation.remaining: Rebuild development folds by sequence family and freeze a new prospective family- and assay-held-out outer set before another SOTA claim.

decision: Do not claim SOTA or sub-0.30 performance from the historical test. Require a new sealed lockbox plus protein-cluster confidence intervals.
